description.purpose: The objects hive as a node source of the graph space: `outline` (the object node, anchor '', and one node per filled slot) and `links` (`owner`, `doc`, `related`, all `extracted`) of the current version of an active row, in the file space's answer shape.
description.use_when: Inside an objects hive only, behind `in_read` (a graph space's `pull`).
description.not_in_scope: No `near`, no round check (the graph space filters by the source's round), no write.
description.emits_meaning: `source_store` to `./store`, `answer` (hop `op`, `op_id`, `source` mirrored) out of the hive; `stale_version` for any but the current version of an active row, `unknown_source` for an id without a row.
description.consumes_meaning: A pull and the store's answer to its one read.
